description:
Create a new collection named 'Dissertation Notes'. Then, create two STANDALONE notes (not attached to any paper) and add them to this collection.

Note 1 Requirements:
- Must contain the phrase 'Research Questions'
- Must contain these keywords: 'transformer', 'attention', 'scalability'
- Must be at least 100 characters long

Note 2 Requirements:
- Must contain the phrase 'Key Findings'
- Must contain these keywords: 'pre-training', 'fine-tuning', 'benchmark'
- Must be at least 100 characters long

To create a standalone note: Use File > New Note > New Standalone Note.
To add to collection: Drag the notes into the 'Dissertation Notes' collection.
